items.prompt: True or false: A circle can be folded exactly in half in many different ways.
hints: Think of folding a paper circle.
Does it matter which way you fold through the middle?
Every fold through the centre works.
items.explanation: A circle has many lines of symmetry. Any line through the centre folds it into two matching halves.

items.prompt: True or false: The capital letter E has a vertical line of symmetry.
hints: Only the top and bottom match.
items.explanation: E has a horizontal line of symmetry across the middle. A vertical line down the middle does not match.
